note_en: In 阿福把他最喜欢的旧照片都擦得干干净净, the particle 得 links the verb 擦 "wipe" to its result, and the doubled adjective 干干净净 (from 干净 "clean") makes it more vivid: "wiped spotlessly clean." Doubling a two-syllable adjective as AABB (干干净净, 高高兴兴, 清清楚楚) works like adding "nice and" or "perfectly" in English, and such doubled adjectives don't take 很.
